content:
The unfinished art has an identifiable burden of proof
Specify a curriculum and comparison condition, preregister meaningful outcomes, evaluate transfer and retention, report attrition and costs, and allow independent replication. That is a concrete way to pursue the aspiration the ending leaves open. Until such evidence establishes the package’s effect, the Sequences remain a source of hypotheses and arguments, not a demonstrated general technology for becoming stronger.

quote: You should not be getting all your rationality from one author
content:
The invitation to outgrow the text should be taken literally
Reading beyond one author, confronting empirical results and improving the methods are defensible instructions. They authorize the reader to discard unsupported prescriptions and update obsolete examples. The book is strongest when it offers this research agenda rather than presuming that its preferred community already embodies the completed art.

quote: may have its heroes, it may
content:
Single authorship is not by itself a cult diagnosis
One person can originate a valuable framework, while a many-author institution can still be dogmatic. The relevant questions concern deference, independent tests, corrigibility and the consequences of dissent. The warning is useful when it leads to those observations; the number of founding heroes is not a sufficient test.
